content.short: Beefy is a multichain yield optimizer that auto-compounds crypto holdings multiple times per day to earn the highest sustainable APYs on Mantle.
content.description: Beefy Finance is one of DeFi's most established yield optimization protocols, operating across 20+ blockchain networks since 2020. Users deposit assets into Beefy Vaults which automatically harvest and reinvest farming rewards multiple times per day, maximizing APY through continuous compounding without manual intervention. Beefy sources strategies from the best yield opportunities across all major Mantle DEXes and lending protocols, making it the go-to passive yield solution for the network.
